text:
Maria: quick ping — PR #55421 is ready for merge but I need runtime + platform + infra + security eyes before we ship in tomorrow's 09:00 UTC merge slot. https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/55421 :eyes:
Jasper: on it, tagging @jasper. I'll run the perf test now. can we hold the merge until tests finish?
Maria: yes, perf job started. ETA ~20m. if results look good i'll request the merge slot owner.
Nisha: glanced at the diffs — two small nits in the orch config, i'll leave inline comments. not a blocker.
Sasha: quick security note: need a 1‑liner in the PR description about the threat model for the fallback route and auth header ordering. other than that :+1:.
Dave: infra question — does this require rolling restart of workers? if so we should coordinate with the SRE window.
Maria: no rolling restart needed. change is config-only and supports live-reload. adding command we used to validate in staging:
```
# validate live-reload on staging
kubectl -n runtime exec deploy/runtime-orch -- /bin/sh -c "curl -fS localhost:8080/health && ./runtimectl reload-config"
```
Maria: also added Sasha's threat-model note to the PR description.
deploy-bot: Merge window for 09:00 UTC tomorrow is reserved by @release-manager. Please ensure all approvals are in by 08:30 UTC.
Jasper: perf numbers look good — latency p95 unchanged, throughput +2%. leaving an approval.
Nisha: left one tiny comment about a default value, will follow up but not blocking. approving for platform.
Sasha: security approval posted after small doc tweak.
Dave: infra approves — no restart, no infra migration.
Maria: thanks everyone! i'll post here once the merge is queued with the slot owner. :sparkles:
